description: This source file defines a MotionHandler class that interacts with device sensors to collect motion activity and pedometer data on Android. It includes data classes for motion requests and records, a data source interface, and an implementation using Android's SensorManager. The MotionHandler provides methods to handle motion activity and pedometer requests via JSON parameters, checking permissions, and returning structured results.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for motion activity data, including optional start and end ISO timestamps, and a limit.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for pedometer data, with optional start and end ISO timestamps.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Data class encapsulating a recorded motion activity, including timestamps, confidence, and activity type booleans.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Data class capturing pedometer data such as steps, distance, and floors ascended/descended.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for motion activity and pedometer data availability, permission checks, and data retrieval.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing MotionDataSource using Android's SensorManager for sensor-based motion data.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class providing methods to handle motion activity and pedometer operations, including permission checks and JSON parsing.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles motion activity requests by checking permissions, parsing JSON request, invoking data source, and returning results as JSON.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles pedometer requests similarly to handleMotionActivity, returning pedometer data as JSON.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if motion capability is available on the device.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if activity sensors are available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer sensors are available.

methods.name: parseActivityRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a MotionActivityRequest.

methods.name: parsePedometerRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a MotionPedometerRequest.
